name: index-refresh
question: L5a (#218 comment 7223634913): refresh the stat information of the index only (git update-index --refresh), so that files whose content equals the index, and which show as modified only through stale stat data (line endings on disk), stop showing as modified. No commit.
choices: git update-index --refresh, with no path: it only rewrites cached stat data for entries whose content matches; it never stages content. Offline. A tree unit; it emits no case value.
